title: Replace Zapier: Build Your Own Automation Tool With AI (No Per-Task Fees)
summary: Replace Zapier's per-task pricing with a custom automation tool built in a weekend. Zapier charges $599+/mo at 100K tasks. Your own tool costs one flat subscription.
body_markdown: Yes — if your hosting is reliable. With Blink, hosting is included and production-grade. The honest tradeoff: Zapier has 99.9%+ uptime and dedicated reliability engineering. A Blink-hosted tool runs on the same infrastructure as Blink's platform. For most automation workloads, this is equivalent. For mission-critical workflows where uptime SLAs matter, factor in your team's willingness to maintain the tool.
